stories.title: One dead, two seriously injured in Wayne County crash
stories.summary: A 17-year-old was pronounced dead at the scene and two 18-year-olds sustained serious injuries in the crash, according to the Ohio State Highway Patrol.

stories.title: Lake Erie waves bring Thanksgiving surf to Cleveland as strong winds threaten shoreline
stories.summary: Lake Erie's strong winds drew surfers and kayakers to Edgewater Beach, boasting impressive but risky waves on Thanksgiving.

stories.title: Thousands lose power across Northeast Ohio as Thanksgiving Day rain and wind persist
stories.summary: FirstEnergy reported more than 7,000 of its customers were without power this Thanksgiving. That number has dropped to around 1,500.

stories.title: Semi jackknifes between I-75 and off ramp near downtown Toledo
stories.summary: Crews reopened the exit ramp onto the Anthony Wayne Trail from northbound I-75 around 4:45 p.m. on Thanksgiving Day.

stories.title: 3News Meteorologist Jessica Van Meter welcomes baby girl!
stories.summary: Jessica and her husband welcome baby Elizabeth, weighing 7 pounds, 14 ounces, just in time for the holidays.

stories.title: Annual Meadows Turkey Bowl in Medina County raises money for brain cancer research
stories.summary: The annual Thanksgiving event has raised more than $6 million for brain cancer research since the tradition began. This year, the turkey bowl raised nearly $675,000.

stories.title: Lakewood church serves free Thanksgiving meals, bringing food, fellowship to community
stories.summary: Church of the Ascension has operated its community meal program since 2001. The Lakewood church prepared 100 Thanksgiving meals for the community this year.

stories.title: Parma event venue releases statement following fatal baby shower shooting
stories.summary: Pandora's Magical Events Venue released a statement Wednesday after a baby shower the venue hosted on Saturday ended in a deadly shooting.

stories.title: Winning Powerball numbers for the $31 million jackpot on Nov. 25, 2026: See all the prizes hit in Ohio
stories.summary: Since nobody won the jackpot, the total now climbs to $48 million for the next drawing.

stories.title: Chloe Oliver scores 17, Cleveland State holds off Lindenwood 62-54
stories.summary: Led by Chloe Oliver's 17 points and eight rebounds, Cleveland State held off Lindenwood 62-54 Wednesday night at Woodling Gym.

stories.title: MAC says would-be winning TD for Kent State vs. Eastern Michigan was incorrectly overturned
stories.summary: Kent State receiver Wayne Harris had his game-winning touchdown against Eastern Michigan overturned. However, the MAC now says the play should've been upheld.

stories.title: Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade postponed for first time due to dangerous winds, impacting Ohioans statewide
stories.summary: Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade's 100th anniversary will now take place Saturday after dangerous winds forced organizers to change plans.
